definitions.revenue: Earned: units the contract charged for delivered results, times the price of the offer each request used, in that offer's token. Pending charges aren't counted.
definitions.compute: Known compute cost of customer requests (USD). Calls whose cost isn't known yet are counted separately, never as zero.
definitions.credits: Prepaid customer uses not yet used, as the business contract's treasury showed at its latest observation here.
definitions.network_fees: Not recorded: Everstreet doesn't keep the NEAR fees of its own transactions yet, so none is shown.
definitions.customers: Active: customers who sent a request in the period. Returning: on two or more days. New: their first request ever was in the period.
definitions.success_rate: Delivered (charged) requests out of all requests that finished in the period.
definitions.runway: How many days the prepaid credits would last at the last 7 days' pace of delivered uses.
definitions.cases: A SaaS workflow's cases: open by stage, and the median time from request to resolved.
definitions.totals: Totals add businesses only within the same token. Tokens and USD are never added together.

definitions.revenue: Earned: units the contract charged for delivered results, times the price of the offer each request used, in that offer's token. Pending charges aren't counted.
definitions.compute: Known compute cost of customer requests (USD). Calls whose cost isn't known yet are counted separately, never as zero.
definitions.credits: Prepaid customer uses not yet used, as the business contract's treasury showed at its latest observation here.
definitions.network_fees: Not recorded: Everstreet doesn't keep the NEAR fees of its own transactions yet, so none is shown.
definitions.customers: Active: customers who sent a request in the period. Returning: on two or more days. New: their first request ever was in the period.
definitions.success_rate: Delivered (charged) requests out of all requests that finished in the period.
definitions.runway: How many days the prepaid credits would last at the last 7 days' pace of delivered uses.
definitions.cases: A SaaS workflow's cases: open by stage, and the median time from request to resolved.
definitions.totals: Totals add businesses only within the same token. Tokens and USD are never added together.
